column1: # The lines each scheduled routine's final message owes, each at the start of a
# line of its own. One row per required line; alternatives within a row are
# separated by `|`, and either satisfies it. A `-` row means the routine owes a
# non-empty result and nothing more. Tokens are literal text with no regex
# Read by bin/_run.sh, which warns in the log when a captured run's final message
# is missing a line, and by tests/smoke/check-envelope.sh, which fails the
# rehearsal. In a headless run the final message is all that survives, so a line
# printed in an earlier turn, or inside a sentence, is a line nobody can read
# (#52). tests/static/test_routine_contracts.sh keeps this in step with prompts/.
